Yes. In the kcbump fit (`wiki/notes/m1-210210-kcbump.md`), delta_dust has median -0.987 [-0.997, -0.967], against a prior floor of -1. E_bump has median 5.86 [5.63, 5.96], against a prior cap of 6.

Both ran into their walls, so the prior was setting the answer, not the data. The same fit has photometric chi2 89 and a u* pull of -4.3.

The "wide" rerun opened the priors to delta in (-3, 0.4) and E_bump in (0, 12). Delta moved to -2.09, well inside the prior. E_bump became broad, median 7.9 [5.1, 10.4], and its upper tail still reaches 12. Photometric chi2 dropped to 47 and the u* pull to +0.6.
